venues-default.note: Gallery ranking defaults (rank_venues.py). Fair exhibitor lists and curated-list membership are the prestige priors; hours breadth is the client's 'bigger galleries are open more' signal; longevity/roster/cadence come from research reports (0 until research_venue.py runs). kind_museum is negative so museums rank as institutions, not galleries. require_verified is off until validate_venues.py has run for the city.

venues-la-ranked200.note: LA automatic gallery ranking refitted 2026-09-04 to the client's hand-ordered 'Los Angeles galleries' list (la-galleries-ranked.pdf, 200 entries; 148 gallery-kind entries rankable), top-weighted (nDCG gain 1/sqrt(list rank)). Only the curation-site knobs moved (weights + tiers); refs and list_weights are the 2026-09-03 top-100 fit. In-sample: 7/10 of the list's top 10 and 16/20 of its top 20 land in our top 10/20, P@50 .96, nDCG@20 .93 (live top-100 preset: 6/10, 14/20, .79). Remaining misses are data: Commonwealth and Council (#17, status unknown, no evidence), Marian Goodman (#9), Ghebaly (#11). The APPLIED LA ranking is the hand list itself via content/curation/los-angeles/venue_order.json; this preset is what 'Back to automatic ranking' falls back to.

venues-la-top100.note: LA gallery ranking fitted 2026-09-03 to the client's 'Los Angeles 100 Most Important Commercial Galleries' PDF (92 of 100 matched to the registry; 88 rankable). Differential-evolution fit of weights + list_weights + refs on graded nDCG@100 / P@100 / Spearman; 5-fold CV held-out AUC .93 vs .90 default. gates.kinds = gallery only (the PDF is commercial galleries; the site toggle turns it off). Fair/list multipliers encode prestige: Frieze LA / ABMB / ADAA members / Contemporary Art Daily high, GPLA membership ~0 (already counted by `directory`). Tiers = ranks 1-20 / 21-50 / 51-120 at fit time. kind_museum/kind_nonprofit only matter with the kinds gate off. Ceiling is data, not weights: ~28 list galleries had no fair/list/research evidence at fit time (research run launched the same day).
